segments.text: Tribute to the Troops Highlights, Batista Promo
Batista/Dolff Ziggler Interview- Is this Batista's official heel turn? Sure sounding like it. How could I tell? Because I liked it, so it must have been a heel turn.
Hulk Hogan/Daniel Bryan Interview- Cool moment for Bryan to cut a promo with Hogan.
Paige Video, Adam Rose Promo, Kane/Batista/Randy Orton Int
Vickie Guerrero/Zeb Colter/Jack Swagger/Paul Heyman/Cesaro Interview
Bray Wyatt Int, Adam Rose Promo
Bray Wyatt Int, Bo Dallas Promo
John Cena/Alberto Del Rio/Sheamus/Paul Heyman/Roman Reigns/Randy Orton Interview
Seth Rollins/Dean Ambrose Interview- Randy Orton and Roman Reigns come out to get a part of this brawl.
Rob Van Dam/Randy Orton Backstage Segment
Nikki freezes her eggs without John’s knowledge. Eva Marie is forced to make a decision between her husband and her family. Rosa Mendes returns and reveals a dark secret.
Brie and Bryan contemplate their future after the WWE. Eva’s wedding dilemma resurfaces when she visits her family. Summer Rae returns and reignites her old feud with Nattie.
Batista Promo, Damien Sandow Int, Brad Maddox/Kane Int
Piper's Pit with The Shield- Piper is about to get beat down until CM Punk and The New Age Outlaws run out to fight them off.
Paul Heyman/Brock Lesnar/Mark Henry/Big Show Interview/Brawl

Triple H/Stephanie McMahon/Randy Orton/Batsita Interview- Batista returns after almost 4 years off. Unless he turns heel again, I couldn't care less about his return because as a face. He is very vanilla.
RIP Mae Young/Mae Young Highlight Video
Big Show/Paul Heyman/Brock Lesnar Interview/Segment- Besides Big Show sounding like Heyman, a whole lot of nothing happened here.
Stephanie McMahon/Triple H/Daniel Bryan Interview- The Shield are about to attack Bryan until John Cena and Sheamus run out to make the save.
Randy Orton/Brad Maddox/Batista/Brock Lesnar Interview- Batista is carrying himself like a heel after he was booed last night at the Rumble.

Fandango/Santino Marella/Summer Rae/'Emma' Segment- Somewhere, CM Punk is watching this and thinking, I was a part of this show that featured lame segments like this? If they would cut out crap like this, the show could go back to 2 hours.
The Shield Int, Alexander Rusev Promo
John Cena/Antonio Cesaro/Sheamus/Christian/Randy Orton/Daniel Bryan/Kane Interview
Hulk Hogan Interview- After 7 years, Hogan returns.
Paul Heyman/Brock Lesnar Interview- Undertaker comes out to stare down Lesnar, then beat him up. The stare down means that he wants Lesnar at Wrestlemania.

Paul Heyman/Brock Lesnar Interview- Heyman (somewhat) addresses CM Punk (or the lack thereof) as the crowd is going nuts for Punk. Well, If Punk didn't come back for this show, he isn't coming back anytime soon. The announcers did what they could to avoid mentioning Punk.

Daniel Bryan/Triple H/Stephanie Interview- Great Segment, I was hooked. Bryan gets in a good crack by telling Stephanie to wear Triple H's boots and give Triple H her skirt so Bryan and Stephanie can fight it out since Triple H won't.
Daniel Bryan/Stephanie/Triple H Segment- Daniel Bryan gets his match with Daniel Bryan, and adds that if he beats Triple H, then he is in the title match at WM. Happy ending at WM now?
Triple H/Batista/Randy Orton Interview- Three heels with no of them being too fond of each other at the moment.
Paul Heyman Interview- Heyman plays a video involving Brock Lesnar and Undertaker.
Kane/Jerry Lawler/The Shield Segment- The Shield attack Kane.
Triple H/Daniel Bryan/Stephanie Interview/Brawl- Stephanie and Triple H set up Bryan to get him handcuffed as Triple H beats on Bryan for about 10 minutes.

Hulk Hogan/Arnold Schwarzenegger/Joe Manganiello/The Miz Interview- Each of the first 3 guys get a "shot" on Miz. I just hate when celebrities come in and get the best of an active wrestler. That doesn't make any sense and only makes their own active competitors looks bad.
Daniel Bryan/Triple H Interview- Crowd is going nuts for Bryan and barely let him speak.

Ultimate Warrior Interview- Hard to believe that the Warrior passed away the next day after this. He was inducted into the WWE Hall of Fame Saturday, at WM Sunday, cut this promo here, and then dies the next day. Even the word 'shocking' is an understatement.

Hulk Hogan/Cesaro/Zeb Colter/Paul Heyman Interview- Just when you think Cesaro might be turning face, he joins Heyman as the next "Heyman Guy". With this hot post-WM crowd, it still seems like he is face but I don't think that will remain true when he gets in front of the average WWE crowd.
Daniel Bryan/Batista/Randy Orton/The Shield/Kane/Triple H Segment- The Shield fight off Evolution, helping Bryan keep his title as Triple H wanted to set up a match to take the title from him.
The Shield/Daniel Bryan Interview- From Raw Backstage Pass.
Stephanie/Daniel Bryan/Kane Segment- Kane attacks Bryan with several tombstone piledrivers before Bryan can celebrate his WM title win.
Adam Rose Promo, Paul Heyman/Cesaro Int
Dolff Ziggler/Hugh Jackman/Damien Sandow Interview- Sandow comes out dressed in a Magneto costume.
Daniel Bryan Interview- Daniel Bryan says he is off to have neck surgery and will miss some time.
Evolution Interview- The Shield attack Evolution for the second time tonight.
Triple H/Stephanie/Brad Maddox Interview- Brad is fired from his GM role.
Evolution Interview- Batista quits. For good?
The Shield/Evoution Segment- Seth Rollins turns on The Shield and joins Evolution.
Stephanie/Triple H Interview- They finally strip Daniel Bryan of his WWE Title due to injuries.
Seth Rollins Interview- Ends in a brawl.

Stephanie/Vickie Guerrero Interview- Stephanie says that Vickie has been riding the name of Eddie Guerrero for the last 9 years and that his passing is the only reason that they hired her. Thats messed up. Even though I'm sure they ran it by her before the interview that Stephanie was going to say it, it's still messed up because it's true. By the end of the interview, Vicki actually gets the crowd on her side. Interview went from played out and messed up to wow, not too shabby, especially from Vicki.
Triple H/Seth Rollins/Rob Van Dam Interview
Lana/Rusev/Zeb Colter/Jack Swagger Interview/Segment- It appears Swagger is using his USA pride to turn face against Rusev.
The Miz/Chris Jericho Interview- Both guys are returning but the return is ruined when The Wyatt Family come out and attack Jericho.
Roman Reings Interview- Kane comes out to brawl with Reigns.
Sting Video Game Segment- First hint of Sting as they show a video introducing him as a player in their latest video game.
Highlight Reel with Bray Wyatt- No Chris Jericho, as it appears he was layed out before the interview.
Stephanie/Brie Bella/Triple H Segment- Stephanie gets arrested for slapping Brie Bella earlier in the show.

Triple H Interview- Triple H appears like he is going to make Randy Orton the number one contender until Roman Reigns chases him off. Paul Heyman brings out Brock Lesner and it appears Lesnar will face Cena at Summerslam.

Stephanie/Brie Bella Interview/Segment- I guess I'm not alone when I say that the chick stuff is better than the mens. Having this last proves it as the build up between these two have been really good.
John Cena/Brock Lesnar Interview/Video- Good video, just like something they would run around Wrestlemania time.
Kane/Triple H/Stephanie Segment- Kane hands in his mask.
John Cena/Brock Lesnar Interview/Video- Same video from before.

Contract Signing with Stephanie/Brie Bella- After Brie and Stephanie talk trash, Triple H assists in helping Stephanie pedigree both Bellas to close the show. Another good segment between these two and thats two Raw main events that they have taken in a row. Feel free to step up your game, men.
Stephanie/"Megan"/Brie Bella Interview- Megan says that she has been having an affair with Daniel Bryan.
Face to Face Interview with Bray Wyatt and Chris Jericho

John Cena Interview- Cena says that people have been asking him, "when is he going to turn?" Cena says that on Sunday at Summerslam, people will get their wish and that Cena will become a beast to beat a beast in order to keep the title from getting into Lesnar's hands. Cena wants Lesnar to come out and fight him, saying that Lesnar promised to rip Cena apart, limb from limb so Cena says to start with his fingers because he has too many of them and he's giving Lesnar the middle one. Cena would be such an awesome heel.
Brie Bella/Stephanie Segment- Stephanie has Brie arrested.

Hulk Hogan Birthday Celebration- Fun Segment that turned really intense. Special appearances by Paul Orndorff, Rowdy Roddy Piper, Mean Gene, Ric Flair, Jimmy Hart, and even Kevin Nash and Scott Hall. Hall and Nash get mic time and it sure was nice to see Hall again on Raw but I nearly pissed my pants when Lesnar came out to stare some of the old timers down. The anticipation was crazy, just thinking about Lesnar mixing it up with the former NWO members until John Cena came out to chase Lesnar off. This will go down as one of the best segments of the year. Not too bad of a show.
Triple H/Paul Heyman/Brock Lesnar Interview- Heyman was on a roll! How does he remember all his lines? He's just so good.
Hulk Hogan/Ric Flair/Shawn Michaels/John Cena Interview
Seth Rollins/Kane Segment- They have a Eulogy for Dean Ambrose until Roman Reigns shows up.
